headline: Brazilian real remains weak at 5.78 per dollar ahead of fiscal legislation debate
summary: The Brazilian real held near 5.78 per US dollar as traders weighed domestic Selic rate expectations and upcoming congressional deliberations on fiscal policy measures.
why: Brazil's fiscal credibility and Selic policy path are critical drivers of sovereign bond yields and foreign exchange flows across Latin America.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Fiscal uncertainty and Selic rate positioning kept the real pinned at 5.78 per dollar.
